judgments.reason: The span 'mass in the Bartholin's gland' does occur literally in the vignette, but it refers to the initial 2000 excision site (Bartholin's gland), not the labia majora. It does not clinically support localizing the chondroid syringoma to the labia majora.
The span 'recurrence in the labia majora' occurs literally in the vignette and directly supports the anatomical modifier specifying the labia majora as the site of the chondroid syringoma.
The span 'lesion in the left labia majora' occurs literally in the vignette (CT scan description) and directly supports the anatomical modifier localizing the chondroid syringoma to the labia majora.
